summary.headline: Astronomical Treatise and Codex Riccard. 12
summary.text: Description of an astronomical treatise, including a chapter on calculating how many times each zodiac sign rises and sets and another on the twelve house-masterships, followed by the contents and scribal history of Codex Riccard. 12. The manuscript includes astrological material attributed in part to Nicodemus monachus.
